scores.evidence: The 3 objectives use observable verbs (まとめられる / 判断できる / 説明できる). Each has 2 or more questions with objectiveId: o1 has q2, q3, e1 and e2; o2 has q1, q5, q6 and e3; o3 has q4, e5 and e6. e1 (sharing with a team) and e3 (finding old code before a library swap) are transfer items at apply level or above. The create level of o1 is checked only through the practice (pr-write, pr-checklist).

hook-b1 sets a concrete problem in 3 sentences (「コミットの前に、毎回同じ手順をClaude Codeに貼り付けていませんか。」), and the ungraded hook-q leads into 7-1. hook-q mostly asks learners to recall lesson 6, though (its explanation says 「（第6回）」). The second problem in hook-b1, research output flooding the conversation, gets no prediction.

The prerequisites name lessons 5 and 6, and the text recalls them where they matter (「（第6回）」 in s1-lead and hook-q, 「（第5回）」 in s3-lead). New terms are defined with their English before use: s1-defs (スキル, フロントマター, 段階的な読み込み), s3-defs (サブエージェント, フォーク) and s4-lead (拡張機能). The definitions match the glossary, and YAML is explained inline (「「項目名: 値」の形で設定を書く書式」).

measure.mjs reports 「prose 2167 (budget 1,200–2,400) · read 2594 · practice reading 931 · questions 12 · practice sections 1 · est 17.8 min (must be ≤ 20; estMinutes 18)」, and lint --strict reports 0 errors and 0 warnings. The prose is near the top of the budget. Section 7-3 is the densest: the subagent, the fork, the background default and the agent file come in 7 blocks before its check.

7-2 is a full worked example that comes before the practice. s2-steps has 5 labelled steps, each with its reason (「起動後に `.claude/skills/` を新しく作ると、`/reload-skills` するまで読み込まれないためです」, 「Claudeは説明文で使うかを決めるので」), and ex-auto asks for a prediction. There is no faded example. The subagent half of the practice is modelled only by s3-how's one sentence and the s3-file example.

Each of the 4 content sections ends with an inline quiz (s1-check to s4-check), and every wrong option has feedback. q5 (fork vs ordinary subagent) and q6 (four situations mapped to their triggers, worded unlike s4-table) need application, not word matching. One weakness: q2's answer is the key that s2-invoke names just before it.

Each misconception in the brief is a distractor with corrective feedback: skills load in full (q1 a), a polite request stops auto-use (q2 b), nothing comes back (q4 c), subagents remember the conversation (q5 b), a more detailed body fixes triggering (e2 a), and install everything up front (q6 d, plus s4-pitfall 「最初に全部そろえる」). e6 b corrects the idea that reading more files grows the main context (「読む量が多くても、それだけではメインの会話は増えません」). The practice hint pr-after contradicts that point (see mustFix).

s1-diagram (5 nodes) and s3-diagram (4 nodes) show a process, and their captions state the takeaway (「読んだ中身はサブエージェント側に残り、メインの会話には要約だけが戻る」). There are no decorative images. The s1-diagram labels say 「読む」 where the lesson's term is 読み込む. Its alt also describes a branch the diagram does not draw (「それ以外では本文は読み込まれない」), and that branch is the contrast q1 tests.

The task is authentic: the learner turns their own repeated work into a skill, then compares `/context` before and after delegating. All 7 pr-steps have an expect, pr-checklist sets 5 success criteria, and pr-model/pr-model-lead give a model answer with its reason. But pr-write has only one hint rung before the model answer. pr-after's hint 「ファイルが少ないと、差は小さく出ます。」 also ties the ⑤→⑦ difference to the number of files read, which is the opposite of what pr-c5 asks the learner to explain.

summary-points (4 points) comes after the exam. summary-next has a reflection specific to this lesson (「スキルにしたい手順と、サブエージェントに任せたい調べものを1つずつ挙げてみましょう」) and names the next lesson by its exact title. Then come 6 flashcards and 3 askTutor suggestions.

The earlier doubt about `description: >-` is settled: content/courses/claude-code/reports/facts/cc-07-skills-subagents.facts.md [repro-yaml] shows that s2-skill, pr-model and s3-file load and that each description arrives as one string. The 4 confirmed findings in audit-cc-07-skills-subagents.json are applied (q5 d, q2 d 「フロントマターなどの設定で決めます」, e6 c 「主に」, no s4 caption). s4-pitfall is backed by features-overview ("If descriptions are vague or overlap, Claude may load the wrong skill"), and versions are pinned (v2.1.304, v2.1.198). Not a 4: the pr-after hint contradicts the lesson's own e6 b feedback.

The text uses です・ます and is warm (「まず予想してみましょう」), and lint --strict finds no banned phrases or overlong sentences. Katakana terms carry their English on first use (サブエージェント（subagent）, バックグラウンド（background）). One term is inconsistent: s1-diagram's 「読む」 against 「読み込まれる」 in the text. The ja-editor owns the wording.

The lesson is jp only and complete, diagram labels included. Both diagrams have alt text, and the s2-legacy link text is descriptive (「公式ドキュメント（日本語版）」). s4-table is a semantic list of self-contained sentences, which fits a phone screen.

mustFix.issue: Step pr-after asks the learner to explain the difference from ⑤ (「⑤との差の理由を説明します」). Its hint 「ファイルが少ないと、差は小さく出ます。」 says this difference grows with the number of files the subagent read. That contradicts the lesson's core point for o3 and its own e6 b feedback (「読む量が多くても、それだけではメインの会話は増えません」). A learner who sees a small difference is steered to the wrong explanation (few files) instead of the one pr-c5 checks (only the request and the report came back).
mustFix.fix: In pr-steps item pr-after, replace the hint with: 「差は、サブエージェントが読んだファイルの量ではなく、依頼文と報告の長さで決まります。報告に挙がったファイルの数と見比べてみましょう。」 Leave expect and pr-c5 as they are.

s2-steps ex-description: the `>-` sentence says how to write it but not what it does. [repro-yaml] shows that the lines fold into one string. Suggested text: 「長い説明文は、`>-` のあとで改行し、同じ幅で字下げして続けます。数行が1つの説明文になります。」 (wording: ja-editor).
pr-write: add a middle hint rung before the model answer: 「説明文は「〜する。〜のときに使う。」の2文で、本文は①②③の番号つきの手順で書きます。」
hook-predict: add a second ungraded prediction for the other problem in hook-b1, e.g. 「Claudeにサブエージェントで40個のファイルを読んでもらうと、メインの会話には何が残ると思いますか？」

s2-check q2: the answer is the key that s2-invoke names just before it. To make it less of a recall item, ask which of three skills (deploy-prod, summarize-changes, test-report) should get `disable-model-invocation: true`.
s3-file-lead: `tools: Read, Grep, Glob` is not explained, but e6 d relies on it (「読み取り用にしぼっていた」). Change the end to 「`tools` でツールをしぼれます（例は、読み取りと検索だけ）。」
s4-check q6: the prompt asks 「次の困りごとのうち」, but option d begins 「まだ困っていないが」, so d is not a 困りごと. Consider 「次の場面のうち、スキルにするのがいちばん合うのはどれでしょう？」 (wording: ja-editor).

pr-after / pr-c5: one before/after reading shows how small the increase is, but not what was saved. The hint replacement in mustFix lets the learner compare the increase with the files named in the report. That gives the comparison that o3 needs.

factual doubt: commands.md says 「When agent view is turned off, `/subtask` isn't available and `/fork` spawns the forked subagent instead」. q5 and summary-cards present `/subtask` without that condition. Consider a short note in s3-defs or a troubleshoot entry.
[repro-yaml] was checked on Claude Code 2.1.306, and the lesson pins v2.1.304. The difference does not matter for YAML parsing, but the facts note could say so.

summary: This was a full review, because the earlier verification rounds were recorded against uncommitted snapshot copies. The lesson is well aligned: every objective has 3 or more questions, including transfer items e1 and e3. The 7-2 worked example comes before the practice and explains each step. The distractors cover each misconception in the brief, and [repro-yaml] settles the `>-` doubt. One must-fix blocks the pass: the pr-after hint 「ファイルが少ないと、差は小さく出ます。」 says the main context grows with the number of files the subagent read. That contradicts e6 b and the o3 explanation the practice asks for, so replace the hint with the text given in mustFix.
